platform_mcp_adroll_token.title: PLATFORM_MCP_ADROLL_TOKEN
platform_mcp_adroll_token.description: AdRoll Personal Access Token (dashboard > settings > Personal Access Tokens), sent as `Authorization: Token <PAT>` (https://apidocs.nextroll.com/guides/get-started.html).

platform_mcp_adroll_client_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_ADROLL_CLIENT_ID
platform_mcp_adroll_client_id.description: Client ID (consumer key) of your NextRoll developer application, sent in the `apikey` query parameter on every call.

tools.name: me
tools.description: GET /api/v1/organization/get: the caller's organization {eid, name, created_date}. Default quota is 100 requests per service per day.

tools.name: list_accounts
tools.description: GET /api/v1/organization/get_advertisables: the organization's advertisables (the ad accounts); `id` is the advertisable EID used as account_id.

tools.name: list_campaigns
tools.description: GET /api/v1/advertisable/get_campaigns?advertisable={account_id} (is_active defaults to true, so only active campaigns are listed; `status` filters `statuses`). `budget` is the WEEKLY budget (raw.ui_budget_daily says whether the UI shows it as daily). No paging.

tools.name: get_report
tools.description: GET /api/v1/report/campaign?data_format=entity: per-campaign totals over the range (USD by default). Prospecting and new-style Facebook campaigns are not in this endpoint (NextRoll recommends its GraphQL Reporting API for those).

tools.name: pause_resume
tools.description: PUT /api/v1/campaign/pause or /api/v1/campaign/unpause ?campaign={campaign_id}; `status` is the campaign status after the change. Resuming restarts spending.
